annotations.title: Request on-site photo or video proof

description: Request that a human captures timestamped, geolocated photos or video of a place or object and answers a checklist. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 39 per location in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

questions.description: Optional: yes/no or short questions to answer on site.

what_to_capture.description: What exactly should be photographed or filmed (checklist).
